rationale: spot-check-monthly: the dispatch-only recurring source spot-check call. In build mode the route returns 503 at the global pause gate before any model call; that exit is a run. One run is one firing of spot-check-monthly.yml. Registered so the workflow records its own run (CLAUDE.md rule 17) and the closure gate's NEVER-RUN check reads the ledger row; the artifact is emitted by scripts/lib/emit-workflow-run-artifact.mjs from the workflow's own record job.
